frames.title: Lesson 123 · Subjunctive constructions — practice and contrast

body: **Foco:** Subjunctive constructions — prática e contraste.
**Expressões:** underlying assumptions.
**Pronúncia:** Ênfase intencional.
**22 palavras novas** (problemas sociais).
**Texto do dia:** charge, tirinha e cartum.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo contrastar o subjuntivo com should e com o indicativo, e usar underlying assumptions, numa tirinha.

body: Esta aula treina **ler textos curtos e achar informação (IELTS Reading, TOEFL Reading)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Meeting Rules

bubbles: I suggest that everyone be on time.
I suggest we start now. The clock says it is late.
It is vital that the minutes be accurate.
The data suggests that people forget half of what is said.
Let us ask that each person state their underlying assumptions.
Agreed. I insist that nobody interrupt.

blocks.say: Say which sentences use the subjunctive.

items.q: The chair suggests that everyone is on time.
The member says the data suggests people forget half of what is said.
The chair insists that nobody interrupts.

head: Estrutura
Exemplo
Observação
rows: I suggest that he **be** on time.
I suggest that he **should be** on time.
The data suggests that he **is** late.
It is vital that the minutes **be** accurate.

blocks.body: **suggest** tem dois sentidos: **aconselhar** (→ subjuntivo) e **indicar/demonstrar** (→ indicativo). Compare: *I suggest that he go.* / *The data suggests that he goes.*
✗ *I suggest that he goes* (aconselhar). O verbo não leva -s.

items.s: I suggest that everyone ___ on time. (be)
The data suggests that people ___ half of what is said. (forget)
It is vital that the minutes ___ accurate. (be)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: Is I suggest that he goes correct
items.pt: “I suggest that he goes” está correto?

items.ans: And the data suggests that he goes
items.pt: E “the data suggests that he goes”?

items.expt: Observe: sentido de suggest como evidência.

body: **underlying assumptions** — pressupostos subjacentes
**Take the minutes** — Redigir a ata
**Call to order** — Abrir a sessão
**Stick to the agenda** — Ater-se à pauta
**Table the discussion** — Adiar a discussão
**Put it to a vote** — Colocar em votação
**Second the motion** — Apoiar a moção
**Any other business** — Outros assuntos
**Is “I suggest that he goes” correct?** — “I suggest that he goes” está correto?
**And “the data suggests that he goes”?** — E “the data suggests that he goes”?
**That is correct, because it shows evidence.** — Está correto, porque mostra evidência.

blocks.title: Grammar clinic
lines: Is “I suggest that he goes” correct?
“I suggest that he goes” está correto?
No: “I suggest that he go” when you give advice.
Não: “I suggest that he go” quando você aconselha.
And “the data suggests that he goes”?
E “the data suggests that he goes”?
That is correct, because it shows evidence.

items.label: Ênfase intencional
items.note: Expressividade: varie altura, volume e velocidade para mostrar atitude; uma voz monótona soa desinteressada, mesmo com boas palavras.
words: That is NOT what I meant.

prompts.model: I suggest that she apply today.
The study suggests that stress affects memory.
I insist that the minutes be accurate.

blocks.task: Write 6 sentences contrasting the two meanings of suggest and two other subjunctive triggers.
blocks.model: I suggest that he see a doctor. The results suggest that he is under stress. We recommend that she take a break. The doctor insists that he rest. It is essential that the report be checked. The evidence suggests that most errors are small.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
